title: Trade native commitment classification
description: ADR-SHARED-042 section 14, Decision 8 (Platform Owner, 22 October 2026): Trade is the sole authority for recording each native commercial commitment's classification, derived from a current CP estate commerce profile attestation (control-plane/v1 estate-commerce-profile.schema.json) and independently validated against Trade's actual buyer relationship. The record is immutable: normal Store or Admin operations cannot edit it, and changing a transaction's business model is a governed replacement that preserves history. The database commit fence selects the authorization regime from it: B2B requires the buyer receipt, the seller receipt and the spend reservation in the order's own transaction (Decisions 6 and 7); B2C requires the seller receipt and its own consumer and payment controls. No known classification means no native order commitment. Nothing derives a classification from a sales channel, domain, currency, engine customer type or caller-supplied flag, and the absence of a buyer Organisation or membership is never proof of B2C. This contract activates nothing.

resourceType.description: The native resource the commitment is made through.

buyerAccountModel.description: The buyer relationship Trade positively established. BUYER_ORGANISATION: a Trade BuyerOrganisation with a current membership or a separately approved machine mandate (B2B). CONSUMER: a consumer transaction context under a separately governed B2C authorization policy (B2C).

classificationStatus.description: ACTIVE governs the resource. SUPERSEDED: replaced through a governed replacement transaction. QUARANTINED: a contradiction, revocation or legacy record awaiting governed reconciliation; it never commits.

NativeCommitmentClassification.description: Semantic rules consumers must also apply: commerce_model equals the CP attestation's model at classification time; the CP profile must still be ACTIVE at the attested or a later revision when the fence consumes it; a later classification of the same resource with a different model invalidates authority until governed reconciliation and reauthorization.

seller_binding_reference.description: The seller binding stays independently authoritative for seller of record and legal operating permission; it is referenced, never conflated with the estate classification.

origin.description: DIRECT: a commitment begun on this resource. CONVERTED: it continues another classified commitment (for example a binding quotation or a draft becoming an order) and must carry that commitment's reservation forward, never acquire a second one. REPLACEMENT: a governed replacement of another classification (for example a changed business model). A fence treats a missing or contradictory origin as CLASSIFICATION_ABSENT.

lineage.description: The classification this commitment continues (for example a binding quotation converted to an order), so a reservation is carried forward, never taken twice. Required for CONVERTED and REPLACEMENT, forbidden for DIRECT, and its relation must match the origin.

machine_mandate_reference.description: A separately approved machine procurement mandate, in place of a human membership (ADR-SHARED-042 section 8). Not activatable until its own delegation profile is accepted.

consumer_reference.description: The B2C consumer transaction context under the governed B2C authorization policy.

allOf.description: A conversion or replacement always names its parent with the matching relation; a direct commitment names none.
B2B is a positively established buyer Organisation with a membership or an approved machine mandate, never a consumer.
B2C is a positively established consumer context, never inferred from a missing Organisation.

classificationRefusal.description: Why a native commit fence refused a commitment on classification grounds, each mapped to a decisionReason. CLASSIFICATION_ABSENT, PROFILE_NOT_ACTIVE, CLASSIFICATION_CONFLICT and CLASSIFICATION_CHANGED to CONTEXT_NOT_USABLE (CLASSIFICATION_CHANGED needs governed reconciliation and reauthorization); PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE to SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE (UNAVAILABLE, no commit); BUYER_AUTHORITY_ABSENT to BUYER_NOT_AUTHORISED (a B2B commitment is never reinterpreted as B2C).
